backtest.fix: westlake 2f70628: the bionic shim carries the full bionic->musl selector table and applies it to the app's packaged libraries, not the WebView DSO alone
backtest.symptom: Realm: mmap() failed (size 496, offset 81944): Invalid argument. Its page size came from sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE): bionic numbers that selector 39, OH musl reads 39 as _SC_BC_STRING_MAX and answers 1000, so Realm's power-of-two rounding produced an unaligned offset and the activity died opening its database

backtest.fix: westlake 9b8b861: restriction and profile queries answered
backtest.symptom: UserManager.getApplicationRestrictions reached the in-process IUserManager, which threw UnsupportedOperationException inside a JNI callback; Chromium aborted the process

backtest.fix: open: the app's startup chain never completes the configuration step
backtest.symptom: the app's bottom-navigation menu is empty, so McDBaseActivity.showSelector dereferences a null MenuItem: the ordering host loops on its loading animation and the restaurant picker takes the process down. The menu is built from configuration that ConfigHelper never loads (its map stays null); the configuration itself is present, bundled in assets/server_config.json and parsed into the app's own SDK store

backtest.fix: open: window width comes out inconsistent between launches
backtest.symptom: the app's Upgrade dialog is laid out wider than the 1200 px display on some launches (a window bounds of 1282 px was logged), putting its OK button off the right edge; with no working back key the dialog cannot be dismissed at all
